sub_tasks.requirements: Data and preprocessing fidelity

Skill retrieval implements the four strategies (UCB Retrieval with score(e)=r̄(e)+c√(ln N_ucb/n(e)), Keyword Matching (KM), Full Retrieval, Random Retrieval) from the SkillBank, as described in Section 3.
Training data uses the GiGPO split for ALFWorld, NQ+HotpotQA for Search-QA (in-domain) with E5 retriever, and 1000 tasks for WebShop, as described in Section 3.
Maximum prompt lengths are set to 2048 tokens for ALFWorld and 4096 tokens for Search-QA and WebShop, as described in Section 3.
Experiment execution and reproducibility
Training runs for exactly 150 steps on 8 H800 GPUs using the Qwen2.5-Instruct and Qwen3-Instruct families including Qwen2.5-3B, Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-1.7B, as described in Section 3.
Batch configuration matches: 16 tasks with 8 rollouts per prompt for ALFWorld and WebShop, 128 tasks for Search-QA, as described in Section 3.
All baselines (GRPO, OPSD, Skill-GRPO, GRPO+OPSD, Skill-SD, RLSD) are re-implemented with identical backbones and hyper-parameters λ_SDAR=0.01, β=5.0, as described in Section 3.1.
Evaluation protocol and metric correctness
Metrics are computed exactly as success rate (%) on ALFWorld, accuracy (%) on Search-QA, and Score/Acc (%) on WebShop using the 128-task validation set, as described in Section 3 and Table 1.
Evaluation includes both with-skill (*) and without-skill settings for Skill-GRPO and reports robustness across the four retrieval methods in Table 2, as described in Section 3.
Ablations for gating strategies, β∈{0,1,5,10} and λ_SDAR∈{0.001,0.01,0.1} are reproduced with the same Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct backbone on ALFWorld, as described in Section 3.4.
Result match versus the paper's reported targets
SDAR achieves the reported gains versus GRPO: +9.4% on ALFWorld (84.4 vs 75.0), +7.0% on Search-QA, +10.2% on WebShop-Acc for the 7B model, matching Table 1.
